subject: Biology
title: An enzyme binds and releases
prompt: Show a substrate binding to an enzyme active site and subsequently leaving. Focus on binding specificity, without claiming all enzymes are rigid locks.
learner: Has heard of proteins; no biochemistry background.
styleBrief: Large organic silhouettes with a close-up binding site and direct labels; a schematic illustration, not a molecular simulation.
criteria: Enzyme persists after binding and release.
Label the active site and substrate clearly.
State that the simplified shapes represent binding, not atom-level detail.
